1.web: When we had departed from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course to Cos, and the next day to Rhodes, and from there to Patara.
1.asv: And when it came to pass that we were parted from them and had set sail, we came with a straight course unto Cos, and the next day unto Rhodes, and from thence unto Patara:

2.web: Having found a ship crossing over to Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.
2.asv: and having found a ship crossing over unto Phoenicia, we went aboard, and set sail.

3.web: When we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed to Syria, and landed at Tyre, for there the ship was to unload her cargo.
3.asv: And when we had come in sight of Cyprus, leaving it on the left hand, we sailed unto Syria, and landed at Tyre; for there the ship was to unlade her burden.

4.web: Having found disciples, we stayed there seven days. These said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not go up to Jerusalem.
4.asv: And having found the disciples, we tarried there seven days: and these said to Paul through the Spirit, that he should not set foot in Jerusalem.

5.web: When those days were over, we departed and went on our journey. They all, with wives and children, brought us on our way until we were out of the city. Kneeling down on the beach, we prayed.
5.asv: And when it came to pass that we had accomplished the days, we departed and went on our journey; and they all, with wives and children, brought us on our way till we were out of the city: and kneeling down on the beach, we prayed, and bade each other farewell;

6.web: After saying goodbye to each other, we went on board the ship, and they returned home again.
6.asv: and we went on board the ship, but they returned home again.

7.web: When we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais. We greeted the brothers, and stayed with them one day.
7.asv: And when we had finished the voyage from Tyre, we arrived at Ptolemais; and we saluted the brethren, and abode with them one day.

8.web: On the next day, we, who were Paul’s companions, departed, and came to Caesarea. We entered into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, and stayed with him.
8.asv: And on the morrow we departed, and came unto Cæsarea: and entering into the house of Philip the evangelist, who was one of the seven, we abode with him.

9.web: Now this man had four virgin daughters who prophesied.
9.asv: Now this man had four virgin daughters, who prophesied.

10.web: As we stayed there some days, a certain prophet named Agabus came down from Judea.
10.asv: And as we tarried there some days, there came down from Judæa a certain prophet, named Agabus.

11.web: Coming to us, and taking Paul’s belt, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, “Thus says the Holy Spirit: ‘So will the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man who owns this belt, and will deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.’”
11.asv: And coming to us, and taking Paul’s girdle, he bound his own feet and hands, and said, Thus saith the Holy Spirit, So shall the Jews at Jerusalem bind the man that owneth this girdle, and shall deliver him into the hands of the Gentiles.

12.web: When we heard these things, both we and they of that place begged him not to go up to Jerusalem.
12.asv: And when we heard these things, both we and they of that place besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.

13.web: Then Paul answered, “What are you doing, weeping and breaking my heart? For I am ready not only to be bound, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.”
13.asv: Then Paul answered, What do ye, weeping and breaking my heart? for I am ready not to be bound only, but also to die at Jerusalem for the name of the Lord Jesus.

14.web: When he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, “The Lord’s will be done.”
14.asv: And when he would not be persuaded, we ceased, saying, The will of the Lord be done.

15.web: After these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.
15.asv: And after these days we took up our baggage and went up to Jerusalem.

16.web: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.
16.asv: And there went with us also certain of the disciples from Cæsarea, bringing with them one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we should lodge.

17.web: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.
17.asv: And when we were come to Jerusalem, the brethren received us gladly.

18.web: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.
18.asv: And the day following Paul went in with us unto James; and all the elders were present.

19.web: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.
19.asv: And when he had saluted them, he rehearsed one by one the things which God had wrought among the Gentiles through his ministry.

20.web: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.
20.asv: And they, when they heard it, glorified God; and they said unto him, Thou seest, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of them that have believed; and they are all zealous for the law:

21.web: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children neither to walk after the customs.
21.asv: and they have been informed concerning thee, that thou teachest all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children, neither to walk after the customs.

22.web: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
22.asv: What is it therefore? they will certainly hear that thou art come.

23.web: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.
23.asv: Do therefore this that we say to thee: We have four men that have a vow on them;

24.web: Take them, and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.
24.asv: these take, and purify thyself with them, and be at charges for them, that they may shave their heads: and all shall know that there is no truth in the things whereof they have been informed concerning thee; but that thou thyself also walkest orderly, keeping the law.

25.web: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”
25.asv: But as touching the Gentiles that have believed, we wrote, giving judgment that they should keep themselves from things sacrificed to idols, and from blood, and from what is strangled, and from fornication.

26.web: Then Paul took the men, and the next day, purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.
26.asv: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them went into the temple, declaring the fulfilment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

27.web: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,
27.asv: And when the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

28.web: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple, and has defiled this holy place!”
28.asv: crying out, Men of Israel, help: This is the man that teacheth all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place; and moreover he brought Greeks also into the temple, and hath defiled this holy place.

29.web: For they had seen Trophimus, the Ephesian, with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.
29.asv: For they had before seen with him in the city Trophimus the Ephesian, whom they supposed that Paul had brought into the temple.

30.web: All the city was moved, and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.
30.asv: And all the city was moved, and the people ran together; and they laid hold on Paul, and dragged him out of the temple: and straightway the doors were shut.

31.web: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.
31.asv: And as they were seeking to kill him, tidings came up to the chief captain of the band, that all Jerusalem was in confusion.

32.web: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.
32.asv: And forthwith he took soldiers and centurions, and ran down upon them: and they, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, left off beating Paul.

33.web: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.
33.asv: Then the chief captain came near, and laid hold on him, and commanded him to be bound with two chains; and inquired who he was, and what he had done.

34.web: Some shouted one thing, and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.
34.asv: And some shouted one thing, some another, among the crowd: and when he could not know the certainty for the uproar, he commanded him to be brought into the castle.

35.web: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;
35.asv: And when he came upon the stairs, so it was that he was borne of the soldiers for the violence of the crowd;

36.web: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”
36.asv: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, Away with him.

37.web: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?
37.asv: And as Paul was about to be brought into the castle, he saith unto the chief captain, May I say something unto thee? And he said, Dost thou know Greek?

38.web: Aren’t you then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”
38.asv: Art thou not then the Egyptian, who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?

39.web: But Paul said, “I am a Jew, from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”
39.asv: But Paul said, I am a Jew, of Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no mean city: and I beseech thee, give me leave to speak unto the people.

40.web: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,
40.asv: And when he had given him leave, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with the hand unto the people; and when there was made a great silence, he spake unto them in the Hebrew language, saying,
